summary: A trail of links showing where you are in a hierarchy, like Settings > Privacy > History.
description: A breadcrumb navigation group. Renders its child moz-breadcrumb elements inside a <nav><ol> list, automatically assigning positional slots and marking the last breadcrumb as the current page via aria-current. Defined alongside a related moz-breadcrumb element (the individual breadcrumb link/label) in the same file.

slots.name: <index>
slots.description: Positional slots (0, 1, 2, ...) that each moz-breadcrumb child is automatically assigned to, one per <li> in the rendered <ol>.
